### ⚙️ Reasoning
The proposal is fundamentally flawed because a URL often does not uniquely define the state or the content of an API response. Relying solely on the URL ignores critical aspects of the request (headers, method, body) that can alter the outcome. This leads directly to correctness failures (serving stale/wrong data) and potential security risks (insecure data leakage or incorrect authorization). The solution requires a composite cache key that fully represents the request, not just the endpoint address.
